description:
Position: .Net Developer
 Location: Southborough, MA 
 Duration: 6 Months +
 Rate: Open
 

 

 local, direct candidates preferred. 
 No option for remote work. 
 Must relocate for the duration of the project without expenses. 
 

 1. 10+ years of development experience 
 2. Expert C#, .NET 2010/12 and SQL2008/12 programming skills are required. 
 3. Must have experiences on leading SOA framework implementation using Java and/or .NET 
 4. Must have hands on experience on ASP.NET MVC, LINQ, Entity Framework, AJAX, and JQuery 
 5. Experience in UI integration using AngularJS, CSS3, HTML5, Bootstrap is a plus 
 6. Experience building REST web services to wrap MS SQL Server Store Procedures. 
 7. Must be able to quickly make enhancements and solve complex issues to both custom and turnkey applications. 
 8. Must be detail oriented with the ability to quickly produce high quality, efficiently running, secure software code.
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
